pageText.چارچوبی برای ساخت کسب‌وکارهای معنادار: A framework for building meaningful businesses
pageText.با ایده‌های شکل‌دهنده به عمارت کسب‌وکار: Explore the ideas behind the Business Mansion: an integrated approach to business foundations, brand meaning, and market relationships, connected through research, education, and practical insight.
pageText.نمای کلاسیک یک عمارت با سه دروازه به‌هم‌: A classical mansion with three interconnected gates
Build the underlying logic of the business.
pageText.هدف، مدل کسب‌وکار، توانمندی‌ها و انتخاب‌: Purpose, business model, capabilities, and choices that give a business its structure.
Clarify and distinguish the meaning of the brand.
pageText.هویت، معماری برند و تجربه‌ای که کسب‌وکار: Identity, brand architecture, and experiences that connect a business with people.
Connect value with the world around you.
pageText.جایگاه‌یابی، مشتریان، روابط و تناسب پاید: Positioning, customers, relationships, and lasting fit with market needs.
pageText.سه خدمت جدا از هم نیستند؛ بلکه سه بُعد ب: These are not separate services, but three interconnected dimensions of one business. Each gate opens onto a growing collection of ideas, publications, and learning experiences.
pageText.آنچه اجزای کسب‌وکار را به هم پیوند می‌ده: What connects the parts of a business: purpose, business model, strategy, capabilities, and operating logic.
pageText.چگونگی شکل‌گیری هویت و معنای متمایز کسب‌: How a distinctive business identity and meaning take shape through brand identity, experience, brand architecture, and reputation.
pageText.جایی که ارزش با انسان‌ها روبه‌رو می‌شود:: Where value meets people: customer needs, positioning, competition, partnerships, and growth.
pageText.مجموعه‌ای زنده از پژوهش‌ها، کتاب‌ها، گفت: A living collection of research, books, conversations, and learning experiences organized around the Business Mansion framework.
pageText.ایده‌ها و چارچوب‌های جامع برای درک معمار: Ideas and comprehensive frameworks for understanding business architecture and brand systems.
pageText.دیدگاه‌هایی مبتنی بر پژوهش درباره انتخاب: Research-informed perspectives on the choices that shape businesses and brands.
pageText.گفت‌وگوها، سخنرانی‌ها و نشست‌های ضبط‌شده: Conversations, talks, and recorded sessions on strategic thinking in business.
pageText.یادگیری ساختاریافته برای دانشجویان، متخص: Structured learning for students, professionals, leaders, and teams.
pageText.دکتر سید مرتضی عظیم‌زاده به بررسی پیونده: Dr. Seyed Morteza Azimzadeh explores the connections between business design, brand architecture, and strategic growth. This website brings his work and thinking together in one place: a space for ideas, research, education, and conversation.
